newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK drops on sales, SEAQ pressure - traders.
newsitem.headline: TVK drops on sales, SEAQ pressure - traders.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian chemicals TVK tumbled more than five percent in early trade on Wendesday in what traders said was a correction of a more than seven percent gain in TVK shares on Tuesday.
TVK shares opened at 2,185 forints, below Tuesday's close of 2,220. It touched a day low of 2,090 forints but rebounded and at 1106 GMT it traded at 2,115 forints.
Traders said Tuesday's rally, propelled by domestic investors, made TVK's price attractive for profit-taking.
"Domestic investors pushed TVK's price up yesterday, making it attractive for foreigners to sell now," one trader said.
"One reason is that foreign investors keep on selling the paper," another trader said, adding that he expected the fall in TVK shares to bottom out at around 2,100 forints.
The more than seven percent surge in TVK shares was said to be the main driving force behind the BUX index's rise on Tuesday.
But traders cited an other reason as well.

"One reason behind the fall is that on Tuesday TVK's price on the Budapest bourse surpassed its price on London's SEAQ by some 50 to 70 forints," one trader said. "From this point of view the fall was natural."
Traders added there were no fresh developments around the company which could explain the fall.
